item.title: TrueCar Cuts 30% of Workforce in Major Restructuring Following Return to Private Ownership
item.description: TrueCar, the Santa Monica-based automotive marketplace, laid off 30% of its workforce (under 100 employees) following its return to private ownership in January 2024.

item.title: UCLA Researchers Partner with Watts Organization for Clean Soil Event
item.description: UCLA researchers offer free soil contamination testing Saturday at MudTown Farms in Watts, with clean soil demonstrations and take-home materials.

item.title: Venice Love Fest to Take Over Windward Circle in March

item.title: Malibu to Host 25th Annual Chumash Day Powwow March 28-29
